messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] fvar function signatures
parts:
Did you follow my argumentation for why base don
our calling patterns in autodiff.hpp? My conclusion is
that we only need:

(fvar<T>, fvar<T>)
(fvar<T>, double)
(double, fvar<T>)
(double, double)

where "double" also allows "int".

I'm fairly confident, but I'm getting used to code
review, so it'd be nice to have someone else take
a look.

- Bob
